command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(uname -m)" = x86_64 || { echo unsupported_arch=$(uname -m); exit 61; }; BASE=/home/ai-core-node/.local/share/omegacv1-test-platform; DEST=$BASE/toolchains/go1.27.1; test ! -e "$DEST/bin/go" || { "$DEST/bin/go" version; exit 0; }; mkdir -p "$BASE/toolchains"; TMP=$(mktemp -d "$BASE/toolchains/.go-install.XXXXXX"); curl -fsSL 'https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all' -o "$TMP/dl.json"; SHA=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); print(next(f["sha256"] for r in d if r["version"]=="go1.27.1" for f in r["files"] if f["filename"]=="go1.27.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz"))' "$TMP/dl.json"); test -n "$SHA"; curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.27.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz -o "$TMP/go.tgz"; printf '%s  %s\n' "$SHA" "$TMP/go.tgz" | sha256sum -c -; mkdir -p "$DEST"; tar -xzf "$TMP/go.tgz" -C "$DEST" --strip-components=1; "$DEST/bin/go" version; echo GO_TOOLCHAIN_INSTALL_PASS
